name: cpmfl
description: Read-only access to your own Campbell Property Management HOA balance, bills, payments, requests and association documents, through the open-source cpmfl CLI.
long_description: Ask Claude about your HOA account at Campbell Property Management: what you owe and when the next charge lands, what past charges came to, which payments posted, where your requests stand, and what the association has published. Five read-only tools, campbell_balance, campbell_bills, campbell_payments, campbell_requests and campbell_documents; nothing can make a payment, change autopay, submit a request or change anything at the portal. The extension asks for no password: first install the cpmfl CLI and run `cpmfl auth login` in a terminal. That caches a session token in your OS keychain, and the bundled cpmfl reads it from there. When the session expires, run `cpmfl auth login` again. On macOS the first call asks for keychain access; choose Always Allow. What the tools return (balance, charges, payments, property address, requests) goes to Claude as part of your conversation. Unofficial; not affiliated with Campbell Property Management or Vantaca.

tools.name: campbell_balance
tools.description: What you owe the association now, when the next charge lands, and whether autopay is on.

tools.name: campbell_bills
tools.description: Charges on your ledger, and any assessed but not yet posted.

tools.name: campbell_requests
tools.description: The homeowner requests you submitted, and where they stand.

tools.name: campbell_documents
tools.description: Find the association's published documents by name, or list a folder.
